_comment: ZeRO-3 for Qwen2.5-VL. The 'auto' values are a HuggingFace Trainer convention, not a DeepSpeed feature: Trainer substitutes its own TrainingArguments before DeepSpeed sees this file. Launch without Trainer and 'auto' is a parse error.

zero_optimization._stage_comment: Stage 3 shards the PARAMETERS too, not just optimizer states and gradients. That costs 1.5x the communication of stage 2 (3-psi vs 2-psi) and is still the right call here, because a video batch needs every spare byte for activations rather than for a resident copy of the weights.
zero_optimization._offload_comment: Uncomment to trade speed for VRAM if 3B still will not fit. CPU offload costs roughly 2-3x step time over PCIe; try lowering --max-frames first, since visual tokens dominate here, not weights.
